crew.overview: Recently fired and desperate for work, a troubled young man named Mike agrees to take a position as a night security guard at an abandoned theme restaurant: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. But he soon discovers that nothing at Freddy's is what it seems.
crew.title: Five Nights at Freddy's

details.biography: Dante Dammit is an American filmmaker, actress, writer, and producer. A graduate of Columbia College Chicago, they draw inspiration from horror films, comic books, and punk rock to create a macabre, shock-driven brand of storytelling infused with postmodern comedy and unapologetic schlock. Their work has been featured at festivals including the Chicago Indie Horror Film Festival, Planet 9 Film Fest, and Exposures Montreal Trans Film Festival.
details.name: Dante Dammit
